warmups.name: Rowing Machine Warm-up
warmups.precautions: Flat back - hinge at hips, spine long and neutral;Chest tall, shoulders down away from ears;Elbows track close to body, squeeze shoulder blades
warmups.cues: Flat back, chest tall;Pull to belly, squeeze shoulder blades;Lower slowly, arms straight

warmups.name: Cat-Cow
warmups.precautions: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips;Move spine slowly one segment at a time;Head follows spine - no forcing neck
warmups.cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips;Round back up slowly;Then gently arch and look up

warmups.name: Scapula Pulls
warmups.precautions: Arms completely straight the whole time;Movement only from shoulder blades;Hang tall - no bending elbows to help
warmups.cues: Arms straight the whole time;Pull shoulder blades down and together;Small, slow movement

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.precautions: Sit tall, chest up, slight lean back (not rocking);Shoulders down away from ears before you pull;Pull to upper chest - elbows go down and back;Control all the way up to a full stretch
exercises.cues: Chest tall, slight lean back;Pull bar to upper chest;Control the bar all the way up

steps.dont: Sit tall, chest up, slight lean back (not rocking)
Pull to upper chest - elbows go down and back

steps.do: Control the bar all the way up
steps.dont: Control all the way up to a full stretch

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.precautions: Flat back - hinge at hips, spine long and neutral;Chest tall, shoulders down away from ears;Elbows track close to body, squeeze shoulder blades;No rounding of lower back at any point
exercises.cues: Flat back, chest tall;Pull to belly, squeeze shoulder blades;Lower slowly, arms straight

steps.dont: Flat back - hinge at hips, spine long and neutral

steps.do: Pull to belly, squeeze shoulder blades
steps.dont: Elbows track close to body, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Single-Arm KB Row
exercises.precautions: Flat back - hinge at hips, spine long and neutral;Chest tall, shoulders down away from ears;Elbows track close to body, squeeze shoulder blades;No rounding of lower back at any point
exercises.cues: Flat back, chest tall;Pull to belly, squeeze shoulder blades;Lower slowly, arms straight

steps.dont: Flat back - hinge at hips, spine long and neutral

steps.do: Pull to belly, squeeze shoulder blades
steps.dont: Elbows track close to body, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.precautions: Flat back - hinge at hips, spine long and neutral;Chest tall, shoulders down away from ears;Elbows track close to body, squeeze shoulder blades;No rounding of lower back at any point
exercises.cues: Flat back, chest tall;Pull to belly, squeeze shoulder blades;Lower slowly, arms straight

exercises.name: Chest-Supported DB Row
exercises.precautions: Chest fully on the incline bench pad - stay planted;Neck neutral - look down, don't crane up;Elbows track close - squeeze shoulder blades at top;No kicking with legs - only arms move
exercises.cues: Lie chest-down on incline bench;Row dumbbells to hips;Lower slowly to straight arms

steps.dont: Chest fully on the incline bench pad - stay planted
Elbows track close - squeeze shoulder blades at top

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.precautions: Stand tall facing cable, slight hinge, flat back;Arms straight with a soft elbow bend that never changes;Pull bar to thighs in an arc - ribs down;Shoulders stay down - lats do the work, not arms
exercises.cues: Grip bar high, arms straight;Pull down to thighs;Slowly return to stretch overhead

steps.dont: Arms straight with a soft elbow bend that never changes
Pull bar to thighs in an arc - ribs down

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.precautions: Hips on the pad edge, spine long and neutral;Cross arms on chest - no hands behind head pulling neck;Hinge from hips only - back never rounds or over-arches;Stop when body is one straight line - don't go higher
exercises.cues: Set pad at hip crease;Hinge down slowly;Rise to straight line, squeeze glutes

exercises.name: Mid Row Machine
exercises.precautions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your chest;Chest stays against the pad the whole set;Pull by driving your elbows back - squeeze your shoulder blades;Keep shoulders down - do not shrug toward your ears
exercises.cues: Chest on the pad;Drive elbows back, squeeze blades;Return slowly to a stretch

steps.dont: Chest stays against the pad the whole set
Pull by driving your elbows back - squeeze your shoulder blades

exercises.name: Back Extension Machine
exercises.precautions: Back flat against the pad the whole set;Push back by extending from your lower back and hips - never jerk;Stop when your body is one straight line - do not over-arch;Keep feet on the footrests and return slowly
exercises.cues: Back flat on the pad;Push back to a straight line;Return slowly with control

steps.dont: Back flat against the pad the whole set

steps.do: Push back to a straight line
steps.dont: Stop when your body is one straight line - do not over-arch
Keep feet on the footrests and return slowly

exercises.name: Alternate Arm Rows
exercises.precautions: Hinged position, back flat and still;Row one dumbbell to your hip while the other arm hangs;Alternate without twisting your torso;Elbow drives back, not up
exercises.cues: Hinge, brace;Row one side, then the other;Keep hips square

steps.dont: Hinged position, back flat and still

steps.do: Row one side, then the other
steps.dont: Row one dumbbell to your hip while the other arm hangs
Alternate without twisting your torso

exercises.name: Supine Knee Drops
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, knees bent at 90, feet flat;Let both knees drop slowly to one side, then the other;Keep shoulders on the surface;Only go as far as comfortable
exercises.cues: Knees bent, feet flat;Drop knees side to side slowly;Shoulders stay down

exercises.name: Bent-Over DB Row
exercises.precautions: Hinge to about 45 degrees, back flat, knees soft;Row both dumbbells to your hips together;Elbows skim your sides, squeeze at the top;Lower slowly - no torso bouncing
exercises.cues: Hinge, back flat;Row to hips together;Squeeze and lower slow

steps.dont: Hinge to about 45 degrees, back flat, knees soft
Row both dumbbells to your hips together
Lower slowly - no torso bouncing

exercises.name: Renegade Row
exercises.precautions: Plank with hands gripping the dumbbells, feet wide;Row one dumbbell to your hip without rotating your body;Hips stay level and still - that is the exercise;Set the weight down before rowing the other side
exercises.cues: Wide plank on the weights;Row to hip, hips still;Alternate with control

steps.dont: Plank with hands gripping the dumbbells, feet wide
Row one dumbbell to your hip without rotating your body
Set the weight down before rowing the other side

exercises.name: Body Waves
exercises.precautions: Stand tall and roll a wave through your spine - chest, ribs, hips, in sequence;Move slowly, segment by segment;Never force any single joint;Breathe with the wave
exercises.cues: Wave through the spine slowly;One segment at a time;Stay relaxed

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotations
exercises.precautions: From all fours or kneeling, place one hand behind your head;Rotate that elbow down toward the floor, then open it up to the ceiling;Follow the elbow with your eyes;Hips stay still - the turn is in the upper back
exercises.cues: Hand behind head;Rotate elbow down, then open up;Hips stay still

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.precautions: From all fours, thread one arm under your chest and across the floor;Let the shoulder and side of your head rest down;Breathe into the twist;Return slowly before switching sides
exercises.cues: Thread the arm under and across;Shoulder rests down;Breathe into the stretch

exercises.name: Full Lotus Sphinx
exercises.precautions: ADVANCED - only if full lotus is already comfortable for you;Set the lotus legs, then come onto your forearms in a gentle sphinx;Keep the lower-back curve mild;Any knee pain means come out immediately
exercises.cues: Lotus only if comfortable;Forearms down, gentle lift;Mild curve, easy breathing

exercises.name: Cobra Hip & Spine Rotation
exercises.precautions: Lie face down, prop onto forearms in a low cobra;Hold, then gently rotate the hips/spine to one side;Keep the movement small and pain-free;Lower fully before switching sides
exercises.cues: Low cobra on forearms;Hold, then rotate gently;Small pain-free range

exercises.name: Chin Tuck Spinal Extensions
exercises.precautions: Kneel or sit tall, hands clasped behind your head;Tuck your chin and curl gently forward, then extend and open the chest;Move between the two positions slowly;Never crank the neck - the hands just rest there
exercises.cues: Hands behind head, rest lightly;Curl gently, then open tall;Slow rhythm

exercises.name: One-Arm DB Row
exercises.precautions: Free hand and same-side knee on a bench;Back flat and parallel to the floor;Row the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close;Lower fully without letting the shoulder roll forward
exercises.cues: Flat back, knee on bench;Row to the hip;Full stretch at the bottom

steps.dont: Back flat and parallel to the floor
Row the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close
Lower fully without letting the shoulder roll forward

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
exercises.precautions: Overhand grip, bar fully secure, start from a dead hang;Pull until your chin clears the bar - no swinging;Use a band assist or step if you cannot yet do one clean rep;Lower slowly to straight arms
exercises.cues: Hang tall, grip just outside shoulders;Pull your elbows down;Lower under control

exercises.name: Resistance Band High-to-Low Row
exercises.precautions: Anchor the band high and step back into tension;Pull your elbows down toward your ribs, chest tall;Do not let your lower back arch as you pull;Inspect the band before every set
exercises.cues: Grip high, sit your hips back slightly;Pull down to your ribs;Return slowly

exercises.name: Resistance Band Row
exercises.precautions: Anchor the band at chest height and step back to tension;Pull your elbows straight back, shoulder blades squeezing;Keep your torso still - no rocking;Inspect the band before every set
exercises.cues: Brace tall, arms forward;Pull your elbows back;Squeeze, then return slowly

steps.dont: Anchor the band at chest height and step back to tension
Pull your elbows straight back, shoulder blades squeezing
Keep your torso still - no rocking

exercises.name: Tuck Front Lever Hold
exercises.precautions: Advanced gymnastic hold - the bar must be fully secure;Keep your arms straight and lats engaged;Pull the bar down as you lift your tucked body toward horizontal;Stop well before your form breaks
exercises.cues: Hang with straight arms;Tuck your knees, lift toward horizontal;Hold, then lower slowly

stretches.name: Lat Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it

stretches.name: Child's Pose
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it

stretches.name: Cobra Pose
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
